page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the ARM64 architecture and powered by Alibaba's in-house YiTian 710 processor. The instance provides 16 dedicated physical cores running at a fixed 2.75 GHz clock speed, with one thread per core avoiding hyper-threading contention. It integrates 32 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The processor includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 64 MB L3 cache. Cryptographic processing includes standard AES hardware acceleration, while x86-specific extensions such as AVX or AMX are absent.

Hardware connectivity includes a baseline network throughput of 10 Gbps managed under the KVM hypervisor. The instance features no bundled local storage, necessitating external network-attached volumes for persistent data. Hardware accelerators are not included, maintaining a dedicated CPU-only execution profile.

Benchmark results demonstrate balanced mid-range execution across compute workloads, with stress-ng recording 1816.59 in single-core and 28931.94 in multi-core testing. Memory performance ranks strongly, reflected in a top-quartile PassMark memory score of 2830.40 and uncached read bandwidth reaching 121.25 GB/sec. Conversely, PassMark cryptographic testing registered in the lower quartile at 2612.79, and 7B parameter LLM prompt processing reached 21.3 tokens per second, also in the bottom 25%. Static web serving achieved 23.62 GB/sec throughput, and Redis SET benchmarks delivered 26.66 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the custom ARM-based YiTian architecture delivers strong compute and memory throughput per core relative to resource overhead. The ecs.c8y.4xlarge is suited for scale-out web serving, compression jobs, microservice architectures, and distributed caching systems, provided workloads are compiled for ARM64 and do not require attached local storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the 2.75 GHz ARM64 Alibaba YiTian 710 processor. The system configuration features 16 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading, paired with 32 GB of RAM (2.0 GB per core) and a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. It includes no local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network storage for persistence. Benchmark evaluation highlights strong memory performance, landing in the top 25% on PassMark memory tests, alongside solid throughput in multi-threaded decompression and Redis operations. PassMark encryption benchmarks and medium LLM prompt processing place in the bottom 25%, indicating lower performance on specific crypto and AI tasks. Overall, the ecs.c8y.4xlarge delivers dependable per-core performance suited for web serving, microservices, and general compute workloads adapted to ARM64 environments.
